comments.author: @Norm-t3j
comments.text:
So beautiful, so peaceful.
I'll say this again: if you want to have that "I'm home" feeling come to Canada.  Bring your language, your culture, music, art, cuisine and style.  Bring your laughter and your dreams and your joy, and contribute to the general prosperity of the community.

You will be treasured and protected and safe.

(Sorry, I get carried away by my countries history and reputation.  We are a decent people and I invite you here to raise our flag to celebrate an experiment: can humans of all cultures be at peace?).
